notes: § 1280 removes the hearsay bar for official records, but the records must still be authenticated under § 1400 before admission. Hearsay exception and authentication are independent requirements.

§ 1271 is the business records exception; § 1280 is the official records exception. Government agencies that operate business-like record-keeping systems may qualify under either or both. The requirements differ: § 1271 requires a custodian witness; § 1280 requires the record be made by a public employee within scope of duty.

§ 1560 governs the production of business records by subpoena duces tecum and establishes the custodian-of-records affidavit procedure. Official records produced under subpoena may need to satisfy both § 1280 and § 1560.

Penal Code § 832.7 governs the confidentiality of peace officer personnel records. Official records of law enforcement agencies may be subject to § 832.7 restrictions that affect their availability but not their § 1280 admissibility analysis.
